messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then bends forward and raises both hands to his head before straightening back up.","camera":"Static medium-wide side view at roughly waist-to-head height, with the framing widening slightly to show more of the legs.","clothing":"White long-sleeve shirt under a black vest, brown plaid trousers, and black shoes.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Red hair pulled back into a long ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build and dark skin, shown in profile.","scene":"An outdoor amusement-park boardwalk at dusk, with a red carousel, a striped food cart, and a roller-coaster track in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a cobblestone street in front of a soap/cocoa-powder shop to an outdoor amusement-park boardwalk at dusk with a red carousel, striped food cart, and roller-coaster track. The character remains the same 3D male with red ponytail, white shirt, black vest, plaid trousers, and black shoes, and performs the same standing, bending, and head-touching action. The camera remains a static side medium-wide view, with similar framing and slight widening.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original storefront scene with the amusement-park boardwalk environment from the reference, while preserving the same person, red ponytail, outfit, expression, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved exactly is difficult to judge from the side profile.
unexpected_changes: The character's lighting and shadows now match the dusk amusement-park scene, which is expected but changes the overall look compared with the source.
